svg.title: Order fulfilment process
svg.desc: 40 steps, with nine pass/fail checks that loop back or skip ahead
svg.text: 40 steps, with nine pass/fail checks that loop back or skip ahead

path.aria-label: Request received to Load customer account
Load customer account to Score fraud risk
Score fraud risk to Check 1 passed?
Check 1 passed? to Charge the card: yes
Check 1 passed? to Load customer account: no
Charge the card to Write ledger entry
Write ledger entry to Notify warehouse
Notify warehouse to Check 2 passed?
Check 2 passed? to Send receipt: yes
Check 2 passed? to Validate request: no
Send receipt to Update order status
Update order status to Validate request
Validate request to Check 3 passed?
Check 3 passed? to Score fraud risk: yes
Check 3 passed? to Update order status: no
Score fraud risk to Reserve stock
Reserve stock to Charge the card
Charge the card to Check 4 passed?
Check 4 passed? to Notify warehouse: yes
Check 4 passed? to Send receipt: no
Notify warehouse to Print shipping label
Print shipping label to Send receipt
Send receipt to Check 5 passed?
Check 5 passed? to Validate request: yes
Check 5 passed? to Print shipping label: no
Validate request to Load customer account
Load customer account to Score fraud risk
Score fraud risk to Check 6 passed?
Check 6 passed? to Charge the card: yes
Check 6 passed? to Notify warehouse: no
Charge the card to Write ledger entry
Write ledger entry to Notify warehouse
Notify warehouse to Check 7 passed?
Check 7 passed? to Send receipt: yes
Check 7 passed? to Write ledger entry: no
Send receipt to Update order status
Update order status to Validate request
Validate request to Check 8 passed?
Check 8 passed? to Score fraud risk: yes
Check 8 passed? to Charge the card: no
Score fraud risk to Reserve stock
Reserve stock to Charge the card
Charge the card to Check 9 passed?
Check 9 passed? to Notify warehouse: yes
Check 9 passed? to Reserve stock: no
Notify warehouse to Print shipping label
Print shipping label to Send receipt
Send receipt to Process done

svg.text: box = step, diamond = decision, rounded = start or end
